CA.reason: Not published here: the California Secretary of State results API (api.sos.ca.gov/returns) returned figures but its county status endpoint still showed September 16, 2024 timestamps, so the feed could not be confirmed as the live 2026 count. See the official results site.

TX.reason: The Texas Secretary of State results site (results.texas-election.com) did not yet list a 2026 general election at retrieval time; its election list ended at 2024.

AL.reason: The Alabama Secretary of State 2026 election page listed primary and runoff results and certifications only; no November 3 general-election results were posted there at retrieval.

AK.reason: The Alaska Division of Elections results site (elections.alaska.gov) failed TLS certificate validation at retrieval, so it was not read.

IL.reason: The Illinois State Board of Elections vote-totals page listed only the 2026 General Primary at retrieval; November 3 general-election totals were not yet posted.

KS.reason: The Kansas Secretary of State results page listed 2026 primary files only at retrieval; no November 3 general-election results were posted.

KY.reason: The Kentucky State Board of Elections 2026 results page listed primary recap sheets only at retrieval; no November 3 general-election results were posted.

ME.reason: The Maine Secretary of State results pages returned HTTP 403 to automated requests at retrieval, so they were not read.

MA.reason: The Massachusetts Elections Division database (electionstats.state.ma.us) listed only 2026 special elections at retrieval; the November 3 state general election was not yet loaded.

MI.reason: The Michigan Department of State results site (mielections.us) did not accept a connection at retrieval.

MS.reason: The Mississippi Secretary of State results page listed March 2026 primary results only at retrieval; no November 3 results were posted.

MO.reason: The Missouri Secretary of State election-night site (enr.sos.mo.gov) is protected by a Cloudflare challenge that blocked automated page loads after the first page. We did not try to get around it.

NH.reason: The New Hampshire Secretary of State 2026 General Election Results page lists each contest but says results will be linked when complete; no results files were linked at retrieval.

NJ.reason: The New Jersey Division of Elections 2026 page listed candidate lists and primary results only at retrieval; no November 3 general-election results were posted.

ND.reason: The North Dakota Secretary of State results site (results.sos.nd.gov) still displayed the 2024 General Election at retrieval; the 2026 general had not been loaded.

OH.reason: The Ohio Secretary of State live results site (liveresults.ohiosos.gov) served an interactive Cloudflare challenge that automated reads cannot complete. We did not try to get around it.

OK.reason: The Oklahoma State Election Board results site (results.okelections.us) returned HTTP 403 to automated requests at retrieval.

SC.reason: The South Carolina Election Commission results site (enr-scvotes.org) listed no elections at retrieval.

TN.reason: The Tennessee Secretary of State results site (elections.tn.gov) required a human-verification check that automated reads cannot complete. We did not try to get around it.

WV.reason: The West Virginia Secretary of State results application listed no November 3, 2026 general-election results at retrieval.

WI.reason: The Wisconsin Elections Commission results page listed 2026 primary and spring results only at retrieval; general-election results are posted after the county canvass.

WY.reason: The Wyoming Secretary of State posted unofficial general-election results as PDF summaries whose text layer is unreadable (garbled font encoding). We did not OCR them, to avoid transcription errors; use the official PDFs linked here.
